div.div: Controller::new starts in WaitingToStart (wanted), Stopped or Paused from the saved state. Start clears a crash loop and a pause. A launch that fails is treated like an exit: it goes through the same restart decision. Stop, Pause and Restart on a runner that is not running take effect at once.
